title: Travelling Around The Coromandel | Map & Road Status
lines: Download the Hauraki Coromandel travel app and plan your trip with real-time road updates, trail info, tides, weather, and everything you need in one place.
Getting around Hauraki Coromandel and its townships is easy; make your way around The Coromandel loop to discover all that our region has to offer.

There is only two ways to get to Cathedral Cove beach, either via the 1 hour walk (one way) or by marine access - being boat, kayak or water taxi. Cathedral Cove Kayaks and the Cathedral Cove Water Taxi both land at Cathedral Cove, offering access to the beach.

The best way to experience Hauraki Coromandel is by self drive or with a guided/private tour. This will allow you to freely travel around the entire region at your own pace, and at the times that suit. Some of our experiences are tide dependent and therefore change daily.
Over the summer there is a ferry service from Auckland to Coromandel Town, however, this is seasonal and weather dependent.

What is the bus timetable? The bus runs continuously during the day, you shouldn’t have to wait longer than 15 minutes. This is a daily service, including all public holidays - even Christmas Day.
Most towns are within about 45 minutes drive of one another, with a few exceptions.

To reduce the volume of motor traffic through Hahei Village and Grange Road, there will be a shuttle operating from the Hahei Visitor Carpark to the Grange Road track entrance this summer. The Shuttle will operate daily, every 10-15 minutes from 9am to 6pm.
Paid parking is available in two locations: The Main Beach and Taiwawe (also known as the Bull Paddock) public car parks. Note, pay and display fees apply.
